messages:
mara: Heads-up — I'm aiming to cut the release in ~2h. Can someone give a quick review/approval on this PR? https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321

kevin: Looking now, pinging @sophie for changelog sign-off. main thing is the perf regression note.

sophie: I can take changelog. Mara, can you paste the one-liner you want in the release notes?

mara: sure — here's the suggested entry:
```
fix(runtime): avoid double-serialize in token batching which caused ~8% latency spike
```
Also added an optional config flag `INFERENCE_BATCH_TIMEOUT_MS` (defaults to 5) — should we mention it in the breaking changes? Not breaking but behavior change.

jamal: Reviewing code now. Small nit in batcher.go — will push a tiny fix. If it's only a nit can we tag it for backport to v1.2 and v1.1? release-bot, what's our backport policy for patch fixes?

release-bot: auto:queue-position: 3 — There are 2 PRs ahead. Backport suggestion: v1.2 (required), v1.1 (optional). To request backport, add label `backport/v1.2` and `backport/v1.1`.

kevin: Mara — add the labels if you want both. I can approve after jamal's nit patch.

mara: added `backport/v1.2` and `needs-review` labels. Not adding v1.1 unless we see regressions.

jamal: pushed tiny fix in PR branch — force-pushed. quick run of unit tests passed locally.

kevin: :eyes: running CI. If green I'll approve.

(release-bot): ci: status changed to success for PR #4321

kevin: Approved. :shipit:

sophie: Changelog entry looks good. I'd tweak wording to be user-focused ->
```
fix: reduce inference latency by avoiding double serialization during batching; introduces optional INFERENCE_BATCH_TIMEOUT_MS config
```

mara: updated changelog in PR to Sophie wording and added a short example in docs.

kevin: Since it's labeled and approved, when do we want to cut? still on schedule for ~2h?

mara: yes, will queue into the cut. release-bot, please include PR #4321 in the upcoming cut and run backport workflow for v1.2.

release-bot: ack — queued PR #4321 for release tag `release/2026-03-17`. Backport workflow triggered for `v1.2`.

olivia: quick note — remember to update the rollback doc if we change batching behavior. I'll file a follow-up ticket.

mara: thanks all :thumbsup:
